Apple Slab Pie, Two Trays

Shortcrust slab pie, both trays baked together on fan heat.

20-24 pieces2 h 10 minMedium1 cook

1AssumptionsWhat I decided for you — override anything here

  • Two flat oven trays, about 30 x 40 cm"Two plates for my stove" read as oven trays. Smaller trays: keep dough back or build thicker.
  • One cook, no helperTimeline has a single person lane; appliances carry the parallel work.
  • AEG Competence has no numbered programsOwned oven is a mid/late-2000s rotary-dial model, exact type unknown (B3xxx/B4xxx/B5xxx). Set the function dial to the fan/convection symbol, not a program number.
  • Fan 180 C on two shelf levelsFan heat is the only mode that bakes both trays evenly at once. Fallback: 190 C top/bottom heat, one tray at a time.
  • Firm baking apples, weighed before peelingSoft eating apples collapse; if that is all you have, cut slices 5 mm and add 10 g extra starch.
  • Sweetness tuned to sour applesWith sweet apples drop filling sugar to about 120 g.

2Required

hands-on 1:00unattended 1:102 h 10 min

Tools and parts

  • AEG Competence built-in ovenBakes both trays at once, two levels
    Fan 180 C, upper + lower thirdFan symbol on the left dial
  • Kenwood Patissier XL KWL90.244SIRubs cold butter into flour

Ingredients

  • plain flour900 gdough
  • cold butter450 g1-2 cm cubes
  • white sugar180 gdough
  • baking powder16 g
  • fine salt8 g
  • eggs4dough
  • sour cream200 gadd to bind
  • apples2.4 kgbefore peeling
  • brown sugar160 gfilling
  • lemon juice30 ml
  • ground cinnamon12 g
  • potato starch50 gbinds juices
  • breadcrumbs80 gunder filling
  • egg1wash
  • coarse sugar30 goptional

3Steps

  1. 1

    Prep trays and butter

    Worktop10 minkeep butter cold

    Trays, paper, cold butter, dry mix

    Line both trays. Cube butter. Weigh flour, sugar, baking powder, salt.

    Trays lined, all dry items weighed.

  2. 2

    Mix shortcrust dough

    Kenwood Patissier XL KWL90.244SIK-beaterspeed 1-210-12 min

    Flour, butter, sugar, eggs, sour cream

    Dry first, butter to sandy, then eggs and cream. Stop at first clumps.

    Holds when squeezed, still crumbly.

  3. 3

    Divide and chill

    Fridge4 pieces30 min min

    Dough, wrap

    Two larger bases, two smaller lids. Flatten to rectangles, cover, chill.

    Firm, rolls without smearing.

  4. 4

    Make apple filling

    Adam stainless apple slicer3-5 mm25 min

    Apples, sugar, lemon, cinnamon, starch

    Peel and core. Slice. Toss with sugar, lemon, cinnamon, starch.

    Evenly coated, first juices showing.

  5. 5

    Preheat oven

    AEG Competence built-in oven2 racks, upper + lower thirdfan 180 C15 minfan symbol dial

    Fan heat for two-level baking. Fallback: 190 C top/bottom, one tray.

    Oven holds set temperature.

  6. 6

    Assemble both trays

    Worktop20-25 mincut vents

    Dough, filling, breadcrumbs, egg wash

    Roll bases in. Crumbs, apples, lid, vents, egg wash, coarse sugar.

    Sealed, vented, washed.

  7. 7

    Bake both trays

    AEG Competence built-in ovenfan 180 C35-45 minswap at 22 min

    Bake on both levels. Swap top/bottom and rotate at 22 min if uneven.

    Golden edges, juices bubbling through vents.

  8. 8

    Cool and slice

    Rack30 min min10-12 per tray

    Cool on the tray before cutting.

    Pieces lift clean, filling stays put.

  • Wash hands and boards after raw egg
  • Refrigerate leftovers same day
